objective: Preregistered two candidates A1 (within-week rank of P, primary) and A3 (within-week rank of P minus P7, secondary and decision-ineligible) for the Polymarket earnings-beat odds versus announcement-window excess return.

parameters.universe: resolved Polymarket earnings events with SIP daily bars, close on S at least 5 USD, contract volume at least 5000 USD, matched 8-K item 2.02 time, non-stale P
parameters.return_basis: close(R)/close(S)-1 minus SPY over the same window
parameters.spread: mean excess return of top tercile minus bottom tercile within week, equal weight
parameters.week: ISO week of R; weeks with fewer than 6 primary events pooled with the next week of the same reporting season
parameters.signal: within-week percentile rank of P (last CLOB Yes price at or before 15:00 ET on S)
parameters.multiple_testing: primary; Holm adjustment over A1 and A3 reported for A3

parameters.universe: resolved Polymarket earnings events with SIP daily bars, close on S at least 5 USD, contract volume at least 5000 USD, matched 8-K item 2.02 time, non-stale P
parameters.return_basis: close(R)/close(S)-1 minus SPY over the same window
parameters.spread: mean excess return of top tercile minus bottom tercile within week, equal weight
parameters.week: ISO week of R; weeks with fewer than 6 primary events pooled with the next week of the same reporting season
parameters.signal: within-week percentile rank of P minus P7 (P7 = last price at or before 15:00 ET seven calendar days before S)
parameters.decision_eligible_condition: never: secondary, reported with raw p and Holm adjustment over A1 and A3

sources: data/research/prediction_markets/polymarket_earnings/events.parquet (scripts/build_pm_earnings_events.py; Polymarket Gamma /events tag earnings closed, CLOB /prices-history hourly windows; public, no key)
data/features/earnings_events/{2025,2026}.parquet (8-K item 2.02 acceptance_utc; US/Eastern wall-clock reading, T-03 finding)
data_v1_h20261004_pm_earnings_clob_sipda.join: ticker from the title (checked against the slug) matched to the 8-K ticker within +-2 calendar days of the slug date; S and R are NYSE sessions

feature_v1_h20261004_p_rank.definition: P = last CLOB Yes price at or before 15:00 America/New_York on the signal day S (last NYSE session closing before the announcement: pre-market or intraday announcement on D -> S = the session before D; after-close announcement on D -> S = D); an event whose last print is more than 24 h old is stale and excluded from the primary sample; P7 = last price at or before 15:00 ET seven calendar days earlier; A1 = within-week percentile rank of P among primary events of the ISO week of R; A3 = same for P - P7; weeks with fewer than 6 events pooled with the next week of the same reporting season

label_v1_h20261004_window_excess_return.definition: window return = close(R)/close(S)-1 for the stock minus the same for SPY, SIP daily adjusted closes; R = reaction session (pre-market: that session; after close: next session; intraday: that session with entry at the previous close); secondary exit at the open after R, secondary benchmark the SPDR sector ETF; placebo return close(R+1)/close(R)-1

validation_v1_h20261004_ha_rules.primary_statistic: mean over weeks with at least 6 events of the weekly Spearman IC between A1 and the window excess return; t from the weekly IC series; pooled IC with week-clustered standard error
validation_v1_h20261004_ha_rules.tercile_spread: mean excess return of the top tercile minus the bottom tercile each week, equal weight; net of 10 bp per side per leg (40 bp round trip per pair), stress 20 bp per side, 1 percent per year borrow on shorts
validation_v1_h20261004_ha_rules.permutation: 1000 within-week shuffles of P, numpy default_rng seed 20261004; real mean IC compared with the 95th percentile
validation_v1_h20261004_ha_rules.continue_rule: mean weekly IC > 0 with t >= 2.0; net tercile spread per event pair > 0; real mean IC above the 95th percentile of 1000 within-week shuffles (all three)
validation_v1_h20261004_ha_rules.stop_rule: mean weekly IC <= 0, or t < 1.0: H-A refuted for effects of the size we can detect, minimum detectable effect written next to the verdict
validation_v1_h20261004_ha_rules.inconclusive_rule: between the two: forward shadow only, re-test after 450 new events under a new contract
validation_v1_h20261004_ha_rules.positive_control: realised beat (1) or miss (0) against the window excess return; t below 3 stops the run as pipeline_suspect before any verdict
secondary: A3 with raw p and Holm adjustment over A1 and A3
calibration of P in deciles and the sample base rate
sector-adjusted return if a sector map exists
exit at the open after R
minimum detectable effect from the realised standard deviation
validation_v1_h20261004_ha_rules.scored_only_if_continue: event-level Sharpe of the weekly long-short series and the change in program Sharpe and max drawdown at 0.10x equity notional added to the 2026-10-02 program allocation

cost_v1_h20261004_pm_earnings.primary_bps: 10 per side, stress 20 per side, 1 percent per year borrow on shorts

placebos: within-week shuffle of P, 1000 times (continue-rule gate 3)
stale signal: P7 in place of P (no gate, evidence about timing)
the signal applied to the session after R (entry R close, exit R+1 close), expected not to work
benchmark_v1_h20261004_three_placebos.unconditional_baseline: positive control (realised beat vs window excess return) and equal-weight mean excess return of all primary events

keep_rule: See contracts.validation.validation_v1_h20261004_ha_rules (continue, stop and inconclusive rules). Frozen before any equity return grouped by P, P7 or any signal was computed.
